verdict.rationale: Linear is a SaaS product, so a published uptime SLA and a public status page are fair things to ask about. The evidence pack documents neither. The only SLA mention (linear-docs-16) describes agents that monitor customers' own SLAs, which is a different feature and not Linear's own uptime commitment.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
